click_lineage.history: Initial exploratory capture (interactive_digitizer.py) recorded 72 raw clicks across both plots in an un-scoped single pass with over-counting and duplicate clustering artifacts. In the subsequent precision session (gui_digitizer.py), the operator performed condition-scoped digitization over the 23 measured conditions, recording exactly 33 distinct marker coordinates. All 33 coordinates sit on the main plot area (y in [495, 772] px) and are 100% accounted for with zero dropped and zero duplicated coordinates.
